### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**2** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `120fdfca1f2f9e43971f2078f62169889720c6f5` — the merge of head `67500498c83365efb8748cd065088e749a34e7bf` into base `9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 120fdfca1f2f9e43971f2078f62169889720c6f5 && git checkout 120fdfca1f2f9e43971f2078f62169889720c6f5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710 67500498c83365efb8748cd065088e749a34e7bf && git checkout -B drift-repro 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710 && git merge --no-ff 67500498c83365efb8748cd065088e749a34e7bf

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9e6fee19ea358232196e1f704198612a2de34710
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 席位核对 · PR #34357 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T16:12Z
Head-sha: `6e2297c2acbf8d820618899aa0c40bf89a4b9b97`

**L1 · REWORK(1 项,只改 PR 正文,不动代码)** · area o1-C 定稿评论 6921861946 所钉 head;本 PR 首次 L1(继承件)。merge-base `951eceee`,8 个提交,18 个文件。

**已核、无问题的部分**
- PR 形态:`Fixes #34163`,单卡,与卡的 Suggestion 一致:写 mark,不加参数。
- 代码:mark 只出现在两处首次写入。一处是首个 chunk;另一处是零行时的权威表头。零行时循环在写入前 `break`(`rows.length === 0`),所以 `header=false` 加零行不会写出孤立的 mark。schema 推导表头、又没有可读投影时,零行仍是 0 字节。json 与 xlsx 分支未改。仓内服务端写 `text/csv` 的只有这一处。
- changeset 逐句核对:触发条件(首个 chunk、`header=false` 下的首行数据、`fields=` 或可读投影下的零行表头)与代码条件一致。"csv import already strips one leading mark"有 `import-prepare.ts:49` 为证。响应头与参数确实没变。关于 `Response.text()` 与 WHATWG 解码器会去掉 mark 的说法属实,对客户端的提示也写清了。没有 docs 句子描述 CSV 正文的首字节,所以不欠 docs。
- 测试:新文件走真实 Hono 与 SQLite,按字节读取,pin 住 `EF BB BF` 只出现一次、默认格式、`header=false`、零行表头、0 字节空文件、json 与 xlsx 不带 mark,以及带 mark 的往返导入。PR 正文给了 main 上 6 红 2 绿的读数,并对两处写入分别做了 ablation。14 个 rest 测试文件和 plugin-auth 的 1 个测试文件,只在读取处剥掉一个前导 U+FEFF(锚定的正则),往返测试仍把带 mark 的文件喂给导入,没有放宽断言。`import-template-route` 中三组 csv 的字节数都加了 3,sha 已重算;0 字节那组未改。两个测试文件新增 module-top 的 `import '@objectstack/objectql'`,这是 `check:test-source-alias` 的要求,增长有交代。plugin-auth 测试在 surface 之外,按 bounded in-place 豁免改动,已在正文写明。
- 门禁:本 head 共 55 条 check-runs,37 条 `success`、18 条 `skipped`、0 条失败,包括 Test Core 1–8 与聚合 job、Lint & Repo Gates、TypeScript Type Check、Check Changeset。
- 标题不带 `!`,没有 narrowing arm,不欠 battery。

**R1 · 同类缺陷缺去处。** Acceptance notes 的"Not changed here"列了 5 个 Console 端没有 mark 的 CSV writer(`ListView.tsx:5886`、`ObjectGrid.tsx:1617`、`data-table.tsx:2309`、`ReportExportEngine.ts:54`、`IdentityImportPanels.tsx:87`),并说明"noted for the seat, same family"。这是同一类用户可见缺陷,只记给席位不算去处。服务端导出路径用 `res.blob()`,能拿到本修复,这一点已说明,但不覆盖这 5 处客户端生成的文件。请二选一:给一张卡(#N),或者写明一条可核对的理由说明它们不需要 mark(例如哪些 writer 的文件不会被 Excel 打开)。只改 PR 正文即可,不需要新 head。

非阻塞:Verification 一节写"51 check-runs, 35 success, 16 skipped",本 head 现在读到 55 / 37 / 18。数字过时了,不影响结论。

落地条款:非受管路径,Clause-② no,没有 `packages/spec` 路径,不欠 L2。R1 在 PR 正文收口后告诉我,我核正文即可。分支落后 main,合入 main 后把 merge-only delta 发我;本核对作为该 delta 的基线。
